title: Event
description: One synthetic match event in WHYLINE's StatsBomb-like schema. Pitch is 105 x 68 metres; origin is the bottom-left corner from the broadcast camera; the home team attacks toward x = 105 in period 1 and toward x = 0 in period 2. Times are milliseconds from kick-off of period 1. Schema version is carried in `schema_version`; breaking changes bump the major number and every consumer validates against it.

id.description: Stable within a match. Zero-padded sequence number.

idx.description: Position in the event stream; equals the numeric part of id.

t_ms.description: Milliseconds since period-1 kick-off, continuous across periods (no reset at half time).

clock.description: Match clock mm:ss as shown on the score bug.

player.description: Null for team-level and period events.

location.description: [x, y] metres at the moment the event starts.

under_pressure.description: An opponent was within 3 m and closing at the moment of the event.

attrs.description: Type-specific attributes. Keys per type: pass {recipient, length_m, angle_deg, height (ground|lofted), progressive_m, pass_difficulty, pass_completion_p}; carry {distance_m, progressive_m}; shot {xg, body_part, shot_speed_kmh, on_target, distance_m, angle_deg, defenders_in_cone}; tackle {won}; pressure {duration_ms, closing_speed_ms}; foul {contact_point, fouled_player}; card {colour}; offside {offside_player, margin_m, last_defender, pass_event_id}; substitution {player_off, player_on}; set_piece {kind}; match_metadata {home, away, venue, kickoff_iso, lineups, seed}.
